title: John Berkey's Concept
description: JOHN BERKEY'S CONCEPT (front) was further refined to become the cover art for the novelization of the STAR WARS script; more than five million paperback versions have been sold worldwide. Twin brothers Greg and Tim Hildebrandt did their own version of the first STAR WARS poster (back) without the benefit of any likenesses of the main stars, and it became the basis for many foreign and commercial posters. Here it's shown in a 15th anniversary version.
